note: Cast time, delay, cooldown and requirements of every skill in the first classes' trees, quest skills included, at every level, for level 99 players of three builds with every tree skill learned and nothing equipped. 'cast' is skill_castfix followed by skill_vfcastfix in renewal or skill_castfix_sc in pre-renewal, as unit_skilluse_id2. 'heal' is skill_calc_heal of Heal on the caster itself: 'forced_min' with rnd_force_min, and the lowest and highest of seeded rolls.
